subject: phase3_dvc_medium_calibration
statement: Bind public-environment capacity to an explicit sandbox identity policy after the first DVC provider registration stopped before launch.
selected_option: use bounded_public_dependency_tree.v1 with a fixed 100000-entry and 2-GiB ceiling while retaining the generic dependency-tree ceiling unchanged

alternatives.option: raise the generic dependency-tree limit for every sandbox directory
alternatives.rejected_reason: That would enlarge unrelated repository and library scan boundaries without evidence or need.

alternatives.option: skip mount-source identity for the extracted environment
alternatives.rejected_reason: The provider launch must detect environment drift between authority freeze and namespace construction.

alternatives.option: treat the prelaunch stop as a model attempt
alternatives.rejected_reason: No provider launch registration, provider stdout, usage record, or token consumption exists.

rationale: The public authority builder accepted the 29211-file DVC environment under its dedicated bounded capacity, but sandbox descriptor construction reapplied the generic 20000-entry limit. The repair makes capacity part of the identity-policy name, records a distinct source-identity kind, and uses the same fixed limits during descriptor construction and later source revalidation. The generic 20000-entry and 512-MiB policy remains unchanged. The 257-test sandbox and Phase 3 set and the complete 1218-test provider-free suite passed with five and seven skips respectively.
expected_outcome: A rebuilt bundle constructs and revalidates the DVC public library mount under the same bounded policy before admitting the unchanged three-mode calibration.
acceptance_refs: sandbox and Phase 3 focused tests: 257 passed and 5 skipped
complete provider-free suite: 1218 passed and 7 skipped
the generic dependency-tree limits remain 20000 entries and 536870912 bytes
the public dependency-tree limits are recorded by an explicit descriptor policy
no provider evidence exists in the discarded prelaunch run
